Cisco akademija mrežnih tehnologija (Cis: Cisco Networking Academy is a global educational programme that enables participants to acquire basic ICT knowledge and skills in designing, building and managing computer networks. It provides access to interactive tools, practical training and network simulations to develop skills for ICT careers in industries and businesses around the world.
Nastavni program Cisco CCNA® Routing and: The Cisco CCNA® Routing and Switching curriculum is designed for Cisco Networking Academy participants seeking employment in the ICT industry or a foundation for further career development in specialised ICT skills.
Introduction to Networks (Uvod u mreže): Introduction to Networks is the first semester of the CCNA Routing and Switching curriculum. It introduces the architecture, structure, functions and components of the Internet and other computer networks. On completion, participants will be able to build simple LANs, perform basic router and switch configurations and implement IP addressing schemes.
Routing and Switching Essentials (Osnove: Routing and Switching Essentials is the second semester of the CCNA Routing and Switching curriculum. It teaches participants to configure routers and switches for basic operation. On completion, participants will be able to configure routers and switches and troubleshoot common problems with RIPv1, RIPng, single-area and multi-area OSPF, virtual LANs and inter-VLAN routing.
Scaling Networks (Širenje računarskih mr: Scaling Networks is the third semester of the CCNA Routing and Switching curriculum. It teaches participants to configure routers and switches for advanced operation. On completion, participants will be able to configure routers and switches and troubleshoot common problems with OSPF, EIGRP and STP.
Connecting Networks (Povezivanje računal: Connecting Networks is the fourth and final semester of the CCNA Routing and Switching curriculum. It covers WAN technologies and network services used by applications in complex networks. On completion, participants will be able to configure network devices and troubleshoot common problems with data link layer protocols.
Nakon svakog odslušanog semestra Cisco C: Each semester of the Cisco CCNA programme ends with a final examination comprising practical and theoretical components. Successful participants receive a Cisco Networking Academy certificate for that semester. Each of the four certificates confirms successful completion of the corresponding part of the CCNA programme and identifies the subject studied and passed.
Cisco certifikati su priznati u cijelom: Cisco certificates are recognised worldwide as evidence of the practical and theoretical knowledge required to design, establish and maintain network systems in institutions and companies across all sectors.

Projekat \"Unapređenje vještina i zapošl: Skills and Employment Enhancement in Green Logistics (SEE-GL) aims to revitalise vocational education and training (VET) in transport logistics in Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo and Montenegro by integrating environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles. The initiative addresses environmental impact, social inclusion and governance challenges in a logistics sector essential to regional economic development and alignment with European standards. By developing a unified VET curriculum incorporating ESG principles, SEE-GL aims to equip professionals with the skills needed for sustainable logistics operations. The project emphasises cooperation between the private and public sectors and the use of digital educational tools to ensure broad access and participation. This approach aims to modernise logistics, making it more inclusive and responsive to market needs. SEE-GL focuses on strengthening VET institutions, aligning programmes with labour market needs and integrating local, regional and national development strategies. A key result will be a new generation of ESG transport logistics professionals ready to address industry challenges with sustainable solutions. The project aligns with Erasmus+ objectives of inclusion, digital transformation and international cooperation. Its commitment to ESG principles and strategic approach to vocational education support sustainable logistics development in the Western Balkans. By building skills and promoting sustainable practices, SEE-GL aims to contribute to regional economic growth and environmental sustainability.
